name: Jahanara Imam
contribution: Jahanara Imam was a writer and civic organizer whose public work helped connect the memory of 1971 with demands for accountability and democratic citizenship.
context: Her civic voice belongs to the wider democratic culture surrounding the 1990 movement, even though her most prominent organizing later focused on the campaign against war-crimes collaborators.
impact: Her legacy broadened democratic history beyond party competition by linking civic mobilization, historical memory, and accountability for wartime crimes.
seoDescription: Profile of Jahanara Imam, tracing links to the 1990 Mass Uprising, anti-Ershad movement, and democratic transition in Bangladesh.
